## About

Yum News publishes practical, step-by-step guides for Android, Gemini AI, Firebase, Claude, Google Home, and developer tooling. Coverage focuses on useful product workflows — from consumer Android features to SDK-level APIs and AI integrations. Articles are written for developers, makers, and technically curious readers.

- **AI Tools & Tutorials** — ChatGPT, ChatGPT Skills, Claude, Claude Code Projects, Gemini, Gemini Spark, Gemma, ML Kit, Prompt API, LiteRT-LM, Firebase AI Logic, Gemini Nano Banana image models, Google Pics, Google AI Studio, Google Flow, Firefox Smart Window, Mistral, Google Home MCP, Notion Agent Skills, Gemini Daily Brief, Speech Recognition, Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, Gemini in Sheets, Sheets canvas mini-apps, Gemini Gems, Gemini app for Windows, Gemini app for Mac, Apple Messages @messages, Gemini in Gmail, Gemini in Google Docs, Gemini Google Calendar events, Google Labs CC family agent, Google Labs Dreambeans, Ask Photos, Gemini Omni video, Gemini Spark Google Photos, Gboard Rambler, Android CLI, Android skills, Gemini agentic video understanding, Android Bench, Gemini 3.5 Live Translate, Create My Widget, Google Finance AI Key Moments
- **Android Apps & Updates** — Android 17, One UI 9, Galaxy S26 rollout, Pixel drops, Pixel VIP widgets, Pixel 11 Magic Capture, Pixel Scam Detection, Gboard Rambler, Gboard warnings, Motion Assist, Find Hub Remembered items, AndroidX Security State, Circle to Search, Google Messages Keep notes, Gmail Copy code 2FA, new OS features, ADB, debugging, Android CLI, Media3 MiniController, Android Bench 2.0, Create My Widget, Gemini Intelligence, Google Finance Android app

- How to Use the Google Finance Android App and AI Key Moments
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/google-finance-android-app-key-moments/
  Install the official Google Finance app, build watchlists, read AI Key Moments on charts, use the research tool, and keep portfolios plus scheduled tasks on the web until they reach Android.

- How to Use Pixel VIP Widgets for One-Tap Calls and Texts
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/pixel-vip-widgets-one-tap/
  Set up Pixel VIPs on Pixel 6 and newer: add contacts in Google Contacts, place the home screen widget, use one-tap call and text, notification badges, and the floating switcher from the September 2026 Pixel Drop.

- How to Use Gemini on Mac and Connect Apple Messages
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/gemini-macos-imessage/
  Install the official Gemini macOS app, use Option + Space and window share, and prepare the @messages connector for Apple Messages when Google finishes the server rollout.

- How to Use Gmail’s Copy Code Shortcut for 2FA on Android and iOS
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/gmail-copy-code-2fa/
  Update Gmail 2026.09.07 / iOS 6.0.260907, tap the inbox Copy code chip, paste the 2FA number, and keep emailed codes off your clipboard.

- How to Create and Manage Google Calendar Events with Gemini
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/gemini-google-calendar-events/
  Connect Workspace to Gemini Apps, create and reschedule events with @Google Calendar, use secondary calendars, and let Gemini suggest meeting times in Calendar and Gmail.

- How to Create Custom Android Widgets with Gemini Create My Widget
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/create-my-widget-gemini-android/
  Use Gemini Intelligence Create My Widget to describe a home screen or Wear OS panel in plain language, refine it, and keep content grounded in Search and Google apps.

- How to Set Up Google Labs Dreambeans for Personalized Daily Stories
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/google-labs-dreambeans-daily-stories/
  Install Dreambeans in the U.S. on Android or iOS, connect Calendar, Gmail, Photos, Search, YouTube, and Gemini, then use the finite daily story collection.

- How to Transcribe Audio with Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/gemini-3-5-transcribe/
  Use gemini-3.5-transcribe for files and gemini-3.5-transcribe-live for captions: language detection across 85+ locales, smart vs verbatim mode, speaker labels, word timestamps, and custom vocabulary.

- How to Install One UI 9 on Galaxy S26 and Use the New Features
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/one-ui-9-galaxy-s26-rollout/
  Official 16 September 2026 rollout for Galaxy S26, S26+, and S26 Ultra: install the update, then use My FanCam, Now Brief cards, Warranty and Care, Now Nudge, Interpreter Thread View, and Security Brief.

- How to Set Up Gemini Daily Brief for a Morning Priority List
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/gemini-daily-brief-setup/
  Turn on Daily Brief with Personal Intelligence and Memory, then use Top of mind, Looking ahead, Gemini Live, and item-level feedback.

- How to Use Gemini 3.5 Live Translate for Real-Time Speech Translation
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/gemini-3-5-live-translate/
  Use Live Translate in the Google Translate app, Android listening mode, Google Meet preview, and the gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview Live API across 70+ languages.
